hoy.titular: Last chance for extra seats as Palmeiras play at the Mineirão today

foto.alt: Coaching staff give instructions to two players during a training session at City Bell.

hoy.resumen: The extra seat sale for the final, exclusive to Banco Provincia Mastercard holders, closes today at 19:00 or when sold out. Palmeiras visit Cruzeiro with several absentees ten days before Montevideo, while the Pincha continue their build-up at City Bell.

siete.titulo: Extra seats: sale closes today at 19:00
siete.texto: The additional sale of around 1,000 seats for the final continues via ElevenTickets, only for Banco Provincia Mastercard holders, until 19:00 today or until sold out. It is run by CONMEBOL, not the club.

They play at 20:30 at the Mineirão in the Brasileirão without Gustavo Gómez or Mauricio (back from Paraguay duty), Piquerez, Murilo, Paulinho or Jefté. Brazilian press say Murilo and Jefté should be fit for the final.

siete.titulo: Correa a doubt for the final
siete.texto: He is nursing a grade 2 tear in the biceps of his right leg and is still working apart from the group. Even if he is cleared, he will lack match rhythm: a starting place is far from certain.

According to El Día, the coach is considering five defenders at the Centenario to stop Palmeiras' full-backs getting forward. The staff's aim is to get the squad physically fresh after a gruelling year.

CONMEBOL chose Venezuelan Jesús Valenzuela, with an all-Venezuelan crew and Juan Soto on VAR. He refereed the Pincha's 1-0 win over Corinthians in the quarter-finals; Palmeiras are unbeaten with him this year.
The club invited members of Sabella's squad that won the 2009 Libertadores. Leandro Benítez confirmed he will be at the Centenario: "I'm going to enjoy it, you don't play a final every day".

siete.titulo: Recopa could be played in La Plata
siete.texto: Winning the Supercopa puts the Pincha into January's Recopa de Campeones round-robin with Rosario Central and the Copa Argentina winners. The Estadio Único Diego Armando Maradona (not the UNO, the Pincha's own ground) is one possible venue, but AFA has yet to confirm it.

linea.texto: Leandro Benítez, a 2009 champion, confirmed he will travel to Montevideo as the club's guest.
The women's team unveiled Mauro Silva as new head coach and a project running to 2030.
Jesús Valenzuela will referee the final between Estudiantes and Palmeiras at the Centenario.
Palmeiras wrapped up preparations for their trip to Cruzeiro with five absentees, Piquerez among them.
Palmeiras wrapped up preparations for Cruzeiro without their internationals: Murilo and Jefté target the final.
CONMEBOL opened an extra seat sale for the final, only for Banco Provincia Mastercard holders.
The Pincha could play January's Recopa de Campeones in La Plata; the venue is not yet confirmed.
Operation Palmeiras is under way at City Bell: Medina is considering a back five.
González Pirez on the final: "I think about the match all the time".
Estudiantes trained again at City Bell after the title in Córdoba, with Palmeiras already in mind.
Operation Montevideo: the squad are back in training with the focus on the final.
With the Supercopa trophy and plenty of joy, this is how preparations for the Libertadores final began.
Palmeiras still have no return date for Piquerez: he hurt his thigh with Uruguay and is a doubt for the final.
In Brazil there are warnings about Palmeiras' workload: 270 minutes in seven days before the final.
